subject: NovaLabs POC: success criteria & kickoff dates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novalabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: NovaLabs POC: success criteria & kickoff dates

Alex — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the POC schedule. I kept internal folks copied so Karthik can own the technical onboarding and Jonas will lead the success measurement.

High-level summary from today:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference reduces per-token latency by 30% on your summary workloads and keeps 95th percentile latency under 250ms for interactive queries.
- Scope: 2-week trial against 3 representative pipelines (summary, Q&A, batch embeddings) using a sample of production-ish data (subset you described).
- Acceptance gating: Pass if (a) latency target met on 2/3 pipelines, (b) embedding recall >= 0.87 on the benchmark set, and (c) no data exfiltration requirement violations in our Private offering.

Proposed timeline (please confirm availability):
- Week of Oct 4: kickoff + sandbox access (2-hour technical kickoff)
- Week of Oct 11: integration & baseline run (daily sync as needed)
- Week of Oct 18: optimization & readout prep
- Oct 22 (Fri): final demo + readout with stakeholders

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood technical owner: Karthik Iyer (onboarding, infra)
- Redwood success owner: Jonas Weber (metrics, readout)
- NovaLabs technical contact: Alex Chen
- NovaLabs product lead: Priya Desai

Next steps: please confirm the kickoff window (Oct 4–8 preferred) and that your team can share the evaluation dataset before Oct 6. I attached a short mutual action plan and an initial evaluation metrics spreadsheet to make the acceptance checks explicit.

Attachments: NovaLabs_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf; nova-poc-eval-metrics.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novalabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@novalabs.com>, salesops@novalabs.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaLabs POC: success criteria & kickoff dates

Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick confirmations and one small ask.

Confirmed:
- Goals and gating criteria look good to Priya and me. The latency target is aggressive but aligns with our UX needs.
- Oct 4–8 kickoff window works for the core team. We propose Oct 5 at 10:00am PT for the technical kickoff.
- We can share the evaluation dataset (anonymized extracts) by end of day Oct 6 — note: the dataset will be ~3.2GB compressed. Our security team will want to validate the onboarding checklist (SOC2, IP restrictions) before data transfer.

Request:
- Can Redwood provide a short checklist of the Private deployment onboarding steps and required network access? Our security contact (cc'd) will need that to provision a temporary VPC connection.

I've added Priya (product) and salesops to loop in procurement timing. We typically expect a short MSA addendum for trialing vendor-managed infra.

On the mutual action plan: the milestones look fine. Please mark Karthik as the technical lead so our infra team knows who to expect.

Thanks — see you on Oct 5.

Alex / Priya / team — great, Oct 5 10:00am PT confirmed for the technical kickoff (I'll send a calendar invite).

Here are the onboarding items we'll need to get the Private trial running (short checklist for your security team):
1) Whitelisted egress IPs and temporary VPC peering details (we'll provide a narrow CIDR and port list).
2) SOC 2 summary + evidence request template (we accept SOC 2 Type II; if you have a different control doc we can work through it).
3) Point contacts for data transfer and an SFTP endpoint or presigned S3 bucket (we'll provide a transfer runbook).

I've attached a 1-page Private-onboarding checklist and updated the mutual action plan with the Oct 5 kickoff and ownerships. Karthik — can you prepare the sandbox access steps and a simple verification script we can run in the NovaLabs environment during Day 0? Jonas — please bring the evaluation rubric and an example dashboard for the readout.

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Alex / NovaLabs: share anonymized dataset (by 2027-10-06 EOD) + security contact details (Alex)
- Karthik (Redwood): sandbox access doc + day-0 verification script (by 2027-10-04)
- Jonas (Redwood): evaluation dashboard template + metric definitions (by 2027-10-15)
- Marissa (Redwood): calendar invites + updated mutual action plan (sent)

Attachments: NovaLabs_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf; nova-poc-eval-metrics.xlsx; private-onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NovaLabs POC kickoff + quick coordination

Karthik / Jonas — quick internal check before the kickoff invite goes to NovaLabs. Two minor points I picked up from Alex's note:
- Dataset size ~3.2GB compressed; if we ask for S3 presigned upload it's straightforward, but confirm we can accept compressed tar.gz and auto-unpack in the sandbox.
- Procurement may request an MSA addendum. SalesOps flagged that they prefer a 30-day trial addendum template; I can loop Legal if needed.

Karthik: can you confirm the verification script will run in <=5 minutes (smoke test: model load + single inference latency)? If not, we should split validation into fast smoke + deeper baseline runs.
Jonas: I'll hand off the metrics sheet you prepared — please make the dashboard template lightweight so the product team can consume it in the readout.

I'll send the Oct 5 invite and include the private-onboarding checklist and our transfer runbook.

Thanks — M.

—
